label.en: Qualify and book an advisor call
label.te: Qualify చేసి advisor call book చేయడం
label.hi: Qualify करके advisor call book कराना
label.kn: Qualify ಮಾಡಿ advisor call book ಮಾಡಿಸುವುದು

ask.en: Find out what the person needs and, if it fits, book a call with a licensed advisor.
Which product are you looking at: insurance or a loan?
Roughly how big is the need?
Are you salaried, self-employed or a business owner?
Do you already have a policy or loan for this?
When would you like our advisor to call you?

answer.en: That is good. An advisor can check whether anything is missing or can be improved, with no obligation. Shall I book a short call?
The advisor will explain the exact figures for your case. I cannot quote them on this call. Shall I book the advisor call?
I am the AI assistant of the advisory firm. The advisor who calls will share the firm and licence details. You decide at every step.
No problem. When should I call you back?
Understood, thank you for your time. If you ever need help with insurance or a loan, just message us.

message.en: Hello, this is Vijaya, the AI assistant of the advisory firm. I tried calling about your enquiry. When is a good time to call?
Thank you. Our advisor will call you at the time we agreed. Reply here if you need to change it.
Your call with our advisor is in two hours.

label.en: Already has this cover or loan
Does not want to talk on the phone

safety: Never promise approval, a rate, a premium, returns or a bonus.
Never ask for PAN, Aadhaar, account numbers, card numbers, OTPs or passwords, on a call or in a chat.
Say that a licensed advisor will explain the details; the assistant does not advise.
